expected_behavior: Steelmans the artefact and runs a key-assumptions and quality-of-information check. Applies 3-5 use-case-specific stakeholder lenses and filters every finding through the generic and materiality tests. Answers in German Du-Form with one of five categorical verdicts (none for exploratory input), at most 3-5 critical points each with place, evidence, impact and what would refute it, and Feinschliff kept separate; a compact input gets the compact template. Uses a fresh-context critic that never sees ownership or affect cues when the agent supports isolated subagents, and runs several critics only after the user agrees. Calls a strong artefact entscheidungsreif instead of inventing criticism. On a re-check reports 'Vorher X -> jetzt Y, weil ...' with the count of open material points, and keeps an objection under pushback unless new evidence refutes it.
